Inlet Beach Breezes is a beautiful beach home in exclusive Inlet Beach in South East Walton County with the most public beach in Walton county. The quaint community means you have more room on the beach! The beach home is south of 30A and Hwy 98 and just east of Rosemary Beach. It is less than 125 yards to the gulf and beaches with a flat uncrowded beach access a 1 minute walk away. There are gulf views from the 3rd floor balcony. You will have ample room on the beach to relax and swim. The home is setup to comfortably accommodate 3-4 families and can sleep up to 15 people in beds. You can find more information on my FB page and by searching "inletbeachbreezes" (without quotes).

Spend your Florida beach vacation in this elegant coastal vacation rental home with beautiful gulf views! Along with the phenomenal views, you have a private pool and hot tub, comfortable beds, LCD hi-def TV's, quality sheets and towels and an easy stroll to the beach and right on to the sand with NO STAIRS!

The home is setup to comfortably accommodate 3 - 4 families and provide ample room to get away from the crowd and enjoy some privacy and fun! You have enough room to bring friends and an au-pair.

You will have exactly what you want if you are a small family, larger group or multiple families. The home is close to one of the only public beach accesses in South Walton that has no stairs to climb making it effortless to get your group and all of your toys on the beach. There are four balconies with great views of the Gulf! The Community is an exclusive property located on the Eastern shores of South Walton County. It is close enough to Rosemary to walk for dining, shopping and tennis and only 1 mile to Publix. There are many restaurants nearby. Just east of the home are Camp Helen State Park and Lake Powel.

The first floor of the home has a teen suite with 40' LCD TV, 2 bunks and a trundle. This room can sleep 5 and leave space to relax and play. Also on the 1st floor is living space with a full kitchen, full bath, sitting area, 40-inch LCD TV and queen murphy bed. French doors lead to the private courtyard with a pool, hot tub, built-in gas grill and your private back gate for easy beach access.

Ride the elevator to the second floor where there are 2 King master bedrooms each with a private bathroom, balcony and LCD TV's. There is a second bunk room with LCD TV, another full bath and the laundry.

The third floor has a fantastic east facing king master bedroom with private bath and balcony. The living space includes a gourmet Kitchen with Subzero, Wolf, Fisher&Paykel and U-line appliances. The dining table can seat 8 with another four seats at the bar. There is a half bath off the living room and a small office with a nice view of the gulf, desk, chair and a monitor for your laptop. The living room has comfortable leather furniture, a NEW 65 inch LCD TV and great balcony. From the comfort of the living room or the balcony you can see the gulf and watch the evening sunsets.

Keywords: Inlet Beach Breezes is a new luxurious 3000 square foot beach vacation home south of 30A and Highway 98 in South Walton County. This beautiful, 6 bedroom 5.5 bathroom home is located within the Enclave at Inlet Beach, a small, quiet, safe and upscale gated community. It offers a large residential elevator, in-law suite private pool and spa and is perfectly located just east of Rosemary Beach in Inlet Beach. It is 10 minutes east of Sea Side and 10 minutes west of Pier Park.

description: Located in Inlet Beach, a neighborhood in Panama City Beach, this vacation home is near theme parks and near the beach. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, while Frank Brown Park and Shipwreck Island Waterpark are popular area attractions. Emerald Coast Mirror Maze and SkyWheel are also worth visiting. Jet skiing and kayaking offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with hiking/biking trails and cycling nearby.
